# genba-shorui(現場の書類)

> One offline HTML page for small Japanese contractors: turns a short site memo into a daily work report (作業日報), an estimate (御見積書) and a Japanese qualified invoice (適格請求書) without retyping. Before an invoice is produced it checks the six required items and that consumption tax is rounded once per tax rate (8% reduced / 10%), not per line item. Nothing is sent anywhere (Content-Security-Policy blocks network access). Not tax advice.

一人親方・小さな工務店のための1枚のWebページ。現場のメモから日報・見積・請求書を作り、請求書は記載事項6つと「税率ごとに1回の端数処理」を検査してから出します。

## Use it
- [index.html](index.html): open in a browser; no install, no account
- Installable web app (PWA) when hosted over https: add to the home screen; works offline after the first visit. The service worker caches only the page's own files
- [README](README.md): memo format. One line per item: `品名 数量単位 @単価` (e.g. `クロス張替え 12.5㎡ @1200`, `解体 1式 3万円`). Lines with `※` or `軽減` use the 8% reduced rate, others 10%
- Lines whose quantity and unit price cannot be read stay in the daily report only; prices are never invented
- Optional cost tags `[材料]` `[労務]` `[法定福利]` `[安全]` `[建退共]` (unit `人工` = labour) add a materials/labour/welfare breakdown to the estimate, as Japan's amended Construction Business Act (in force 2025-12-12) asks contractors to try to show. Missing labour or welfare lines give a non-blocking notice; price adequacy is not judged
- Lines in `人工` (worker-days) list the per-day rate with a note: Japan's public-works design labour rates (公共工事設計労務単価, MLIT, from 2026-03, per 8 hours) exclude employer costs such as social insurance; a separate bracketed reference value includes them. Compare like with like. No rate is judged

## Limits
- Saves drafts only in this browser; photos are not stored; no multi-device or team use yet
- Does not suggest market unit prices; does not read text or quantities from photos
- Does not confirm that a registration number is currently valid (see [invoice-watch](https://github.com/japan-ai-tools/invoice-watch))

## Optional
- [Tests](tests/): `node tests/test_genba.mjs` and `python -m unittest discover -s tests`
- Invoice rules shared with [jp-invoice-check](https://github.com/japan-ai-tools/jp-invoice-check)
